plain_description.what: An engineering change: the tool that checks the reserved question pool now opens the database read-only, in 'immutable' mode, after first checking that no pending write log exists. It is verified on every pool of record. No judge calls.
plain_description.why: Reading the database used to create side files next to databases of record, which risks silently altering or misreading the frozen pool that keeps arena questions out of construction.
plain_description.information: Confirms that the guard reads frozen pools without touching them and fails loudly rather than reading torn data. Result: done and merged. Output is byte-identical to the old guard on every pool of record and no side file is created. Known limits: it refuses some database modes, and it offers no protection against a concurrent writer (only a process rule does).
